name: statusline
description: A rich Claude Code status line drawn by a mod: model, effort, context gauge, request counter, cost and 5h/7d rate-limit gauges in the footer, a summary under each turn, a toast when a threshold is crossed, and /context's breakdown in a pane opened from the footer.

ctx_warn.title: Context warning (tokens)
ctx_warn.description: The context gauge turns yellow, and a toast fires, at this many input tokens.

ctx_crit.title: Context critical (tokens)
ctx_crit.description: The context gauge turns red at this many input tokens; it is also the gauge's full scale.

turns_min.title: Request counter: green up to
turns_min.description: The request counter stays green up to this many requests.

turns_max.title: Request counter: red from
turns_max.description: The request counter is fully red from this many requests.

show_email.title: Show email
show_email.description: Show the signed-in account's email at the start of the line.

show_git.title: Show git branch
show_git.description: Show the current branch, and a dot when the working tree has changes.
